caption: The drawing depicts a single decorative object, centrally positioned on a plain, light beige background. The object consists of two elongated, cylindrical sections colored in a deep red hue, each adorned with a repeating pattern of small, white, oval shapes. The two red sections are connected by a looped bend at the upper part of the object, with the top section folding downwards. At each junction where the sections meet or terminate, there are metallic, silver bands encircling the object. Both ends of the object are finished with clusters of white, braided tassels that hang freely. The composition is vertically oriented, with the object standing out clearly against the unadorned background.
title: Coin Purse
